title.zh: 形成的编辑关系纠正已成后继
title.en: Formed correction edits an existing successor

claim.zh: 对每个字母表：在某一位对照参考检查并把该位记号换为参考记号，对每个产物、池与支持都不增加相对模板的缺陷，当且仅当参考在该位与模板一致；对此类位置的每次扫描都不增加缺陷；在缺陷位，检查留下参考记号当且仅当池中有该记号且支持覆盖检查与替换；长度等于模板的产物无缺陷当且仅当它即模板；替换保持产物与池中每个记号的计数。纠正机是单位汲取下的实例：对每个状态与位置，该等价对每个进行中的复制成立，旧忠实扫描定理与单点精确条件是实例，损坏正确产物的旧错误参考在被检位不忠实。旧错误复制留下的产物、库存和连接进入检查／编辑过程；实际材料替换接通释放与随后遗传。
claim.en: For every alphabet: inspecting a site against a reference and exchanging its token for the reference's never increases the defects against a template, for every product, pool and support, exactly when the reference agrees with the template at that site; every scan of such sites never increases them; at a defective site the inspection leaves the reference's token exactly when the pool holds it and the support covers inspection and exchange; a product of the template's length has no defect exactly when it is the template; an exchange keeps every token's count across product and pool. The correction machine is the instance with unit draws: for every state and site the equivalence holds over every copy in progress, the old faithful-scan theorem and the exact single-site criterion are instances, and the old wrong reference that damages a correct product is unfaithful at the inspected site. The product, stock and connections retained from erroneous copying enter the checking/editing process; actual component exchange joins release and subsequent inheritance.

hypotheses.zh: 位置访问、比较、可复用组分的原子替换及保留位置边给定；接线、检查、替换各耗一支持，位置选择和发生次序给定。
hypotheses.en: Positional access, comparison, atomic exchange of reusable components and retained positional bonds are supplied; connection, inspection and exchange each consume one support unit, with site selection and event order supplied.

hypotheses.zh: 参考匹配成为模板纠正需要忠实参考；一般不增定理不保证覆盖全部位置、供给充足或最终完成。
hypotheses.en: Reference matching becomes template correction under faithful correspondence; the general non-increase theorem does not guarantee coverage, sufficient stock or eventual completion.

correspondence.zh: 由同一复制史保留的材料和连接形成编辑关系，差异通过沿实际路由取值而取得；Faithful 不参与操作分支，只作为正确性定理的对应前提。
correspondence.en: Materials and connections retained from one copying history form the editing relation; differences are read along the actual route. Faithful does not control operational branches and is only a correspondence premise for correctness.

detail.zh: damaged 直接执行旧形成、错位及复制操作；新 step_accounts 调用旧 step_accounts，编辑后实际后继接入原复制。
detail.en: damaged directly executes prior formation, displacement and copying; new step_accounts invokes prior step_accounts, and the actual edited daughter enters inherited copying.

output.zh: AAAB 产物、剩余 B、四个已成连接及自初始预算累计的消耗。
output.en: The AAAB product, residual B, four formed contacts and expenditure accumulated from the entrance budget.

input.zh: 检查／编辑过程保留该整个状态，拆回并重接一个连接后执行实际替换。
input.en: The checking/editing process retains that whole state, reclaims and reconnects one contact, then performs actual replacement.

conditions.zh: 入口预算明确为13、14或15；未在失败后补入支持。替换规律新增，随后复制另需其准确读取和供给。
conditions.en: Entrance budgets are explicitly 13, 14 or 15; support is not added after failure. Exchange is an added law, and subsequent copying separately requires accurate reading and supply.

detail.zh: 共同错误来源可掩盖错误或损坏正确产物；预算13时检查耗尽编辑／释放支持，14时纠正完成但不能释放。
detail.en: A shared wrong source can conceal error or damage correct output; budget 13 exhausts editing/release support, while 14 corrects without releasing.

limitations.zh: 未导出参考选择、故障定位、比较／替换微观规律、自动修复计划、自供、误差率或种群优势；编码与动力学校对及同机制传统模型保有可比地位。
limitations.en: Reference selection, fault localization, microscopic comparison/exchange, autonomous repair planning, renewal, error rates and population advantage are not derived; coding, kinetic proofreading and equivalent conventional mechanisms keep comparable standing.

validation_scope.zh: 27项新定理声明／45项新审计，529项实际闭包中484项继承分列；两份原始论文按记录范围阅读并检查关键页，无新经验复算。一般律已由检查器回执绑定。
validation_scope.en: 27 new theorem declarations / 45 new audits, with 484 inherited declarations separate in 529 actual-closure audits. Two original papers are read at the recorded scope with key-page inspection, without new empirical reanalysis. General laws: checker receipts bound.

next_delta.zh: 把已有参考取得／更新机制接到本编辑关系，说明如何辨别共同错误来源、改变所依据的关系，并保持实施编辑所需支持。
next_delta.en: Compose existing reference-acquisition/renewal mechanisms with this editing relation, explaining discrimination of a shared wrong source, change of the guiding relationship and retained support for actual editing.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：新增一个原产物—编辑—后继组合；旧无编辑语法的前缀保留定理与其他校准／社会组织结果不变。
history.en: 2026-10-09: adds one retained-product–editing–successor composition; the old no-editing grammar’s prefix theorem and separate calibration/social-organizational results remain unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-14：按旧记录一般律审计，主张改为一般律先行（新核心模块 Becoming.Copying 的检查律）：对每个字母表，检查对每个产物都不增缺陷恰当参考在该位忠实，单点条件与零缺陷条件分为两条精确的律。外围 CopyingInstances 把纠正机陈述为实例，旧 inspection_scan_does_not_increase_defects 与 inspection_matches_reference_iff 是实例，wrong_reference_damages_correct_product 是逆向一侧。scratch_build 实编；回执由落地运行绑定。原定理、回执与反例不变。
history.en: 2026-10-14: under the general-law audit of older records, the claim now states the law first (the inspection laws of the new core module Becoming.Copying): for every alphabet, inspection never increases the defects for any product exactly where the reference is faithful, with the single-site and zero-defect criteria as two separate exact laws. The periphery CopyingInstances states the correction machine as an instance; the old inspection_scan_does_not_increase_defects and inspection_matches_reference_iff are instances, and wrong_reference_damages_correct_product is the converse side. Built with scratch_build; the landing run binds the receipt. The original theorems, receipt and counterexamples are unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，一般规律计划第三批（研究第114–115节）：审读以下改动后重新绑定：BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md（末尾新增两节（生存核、计数与持续的一般律；复制与回溯读出的一般律）及其英文段，并为第113–115节加注落地日期与回执；此前各节不变）。一般律现已绑定：Becoming.Copying 由核心回执 20261014T044840.291323Z；CopyingInstances 由外围回执 20261014T045347.438672Z；核心公理报告为空，外围只用标准公理。有效范围中关于一般律的说明改为回执已绑定。
history.en: 14 October 2026, batch 3 of the general-laws plan (study sections 114–115): reconciled after reading the changes to BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md (two sections appended, on the general laws of viability, countdown and lasting and on those of copying and retrodiction, with their English paragraphs, and dated landing notes for sections 113–115; earlier sections unchanged). The general laws are now bound: Becoming.Copying by core receipt 20261014T044840.291323Z; CopyingInstances by peripheral receipt 20261014T045347.438672Z; core axiom reports empty, peripheries with standard axioms only. The validation scope's note on the general laws now says the receipts are bound.
Open-issues plan item 17: market words replaced by structural ones (cost, price, budget, fund, credit in the sense of standing); the meaning is unchanged.
history.zh: 开放问题计划第 17 项：市场词（代价、价格、预算、信用等）改为结构词，意思不变。
